title: viola canina subsp. montana
intro: Viola canina subsp. montana, commonly known as Mountain Pansy, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the violet family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful for soothing digestive issues and reducing stress. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Pansy include acting as a demulcent, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, which may help alleviate symptoms of coughs, colds, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Viola canina subsp. montana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
